title: Abyssals v0.90.25 — Field and Capture Fixes
notes: Walter’s menu wraps into two columns, fits the available PWA or APK window, and scrolls with a reachable close header. Fishing contests can start by day or night; each paid contest retains a ten-minute casting window, with a full day–night cycle after the last catch or submission before re-entry. Existing paid contests, keepers, prizes and cooldowns survive reload and travel. Capturing now grants normal EXP to all eligible battle participants, with switched partners, Binoculars sharing, Warbond, catch-up XP and Rimebun yield preserved; newly caught opponents cannot earn their own capture EXP or grant retroactive Warbond. Each Sunken Fort floor has a distinct wild pool; Rimebun stays at 3% on floors 1–3 and 5% on floors 4–5, and all prior acquisition paths remain available. Source and real-browser regression checks; original-key Android signing.
